title: Innervated mouse pancreas organoids as an ex vivo model to study pancreatic neuropathy in pancreatic cancer
protocol: Check for differentiated areas under an inverted microscope and mark the differentiated regions.
Take the dish into the sterile hood and scratch and detach the differentiated cell areas using a 1000 μL pipette tip.
Remove old media and differentiated cells from the culture dish using an aspirating system.
Gently and slowly add 12 mL pre-warmed sterile PBS on the side of the dish.
Remove PBS using aspirator and add 6 mL of pre-warmed gentle cell disassociation reagent (GCDR) and incubate for 7 min at 20°C–25°C.
Prepare at least three culture dishes which were previously coated for seeding hiPSCs, by aspirating the coating medium and adding 11.5 mL pre-warmed TesR_E8 medium.
Remove the GCDR and add 4 mL pre-warmed TesR_E8 medium.
Gently scrape and detach the colonies with a cell scraper.
Pipette up and down 2 times with a 5 mL serological pipette to break the colonies into smaller pieces.
Add 0.5 mL TesR_E8 hiPSCs colonies suspension into the culture dishes prepared in Step 1/f.
Put dishes into an incubator (37°C and 5% CO2).
Gently shake right to left and backward to forward for a few times.
Do not open the incubator and cells for 24 hours.
Daily media change with TesR_E8.
Slowly remove the old medium.
Leave 1–2 mL of the old medium to avoid drying out the cells.
Add 12 mL pre-warmed fresh TesR_E8.
Aspirate the PBS from the dish.
Gently add 6 mL pre-warmed GCDR to the side of the dish.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 10 minutes.
Scrape the colonies with a cell scraper to detach them.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash the dish with 6 mL warm DMEM/F-12 containing 15 mM HEPES.
Complete the cell suspension up to 12 mL in the 15 mL conical tube.
Pipette the cell suspension up and down 8–10 times using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Take 200–300 μL of the cell suspension for counting in a 1.5 mL tube.
Count cells using a hemocytometer or an automated cell counter.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with appropriate amount of STEMdiff™ Neural Crest Differentiation Medium + 10 μM Y27632 to a final concentration of 1×10^6 cells/mL.
Addition of 10 μM Y27632 is very important for cell survival and inhibiting spontaneous differentiation on the first day of single-cell passaging of iPSCs.
Aspirate coating media from pre-coated 6-well plates.
Add 2 mL of the cell suspension per well in a 6-well plate (corresponding to 2×10^6 cells).
Put the dishes into an incubator set at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Gently shake the dishes right to left and backward to forward for a few times.
Do not touch the incubator or the cells for 24 hours.
Daily media change with STEMdiff™ Neural Crest Differentiation Medium during the 6 days of differentiation.
Slowly remove old media without completely drying out the cells.
Add 2 mL pre-warmed fresh STEMdiff™ Neural Crest Differentiation Medium.
Aspirate the old medium from one well of a 24-well plate for organoids.
Add 1 mL ice-cold mouse organoid basic medium to the well.
Detach the Matrigel BMM dome by gently scratching with a pipette tip coated in 30% sterile BSA solution and transfer organoids into a new 15 mL falcon tube.
Fill the falcon tube up to 12 mL with ice-cold mouse organoid basic medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove approximately 10 mL supernatant, leaving around 1.5 - 2 mL of media with the pellet.
Pipette up and down 9 times with a P-1000 pipette using a 10 μL unfiltered tip attached to a 1000 μL filtered tip.
Fill the tube up to 12 mL with ice-cold mouse organoid basic medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 300 μL Matrigel BMM.
Keep the Matrigel BMM and samples on ice to avoid solidification above 10°C.
Make 50 μL Matrigel BMM organoid suspension droplets per well in 6 wells of a pre-warmed 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 10 minutes.
Add 500 μL pre-warmed mouse organoid feeding medium per well.
Change the media with 500 μL pre-warmed mouse organoid feeding medium per well after 3 days.
Aspirate the old media from one well of a 24-well plate containing pancreatic organoids.
Add 1 mL of ice-cold mouse organoid basic medium to the well.
Detach the Matrigel BMM dome by gently scratching with a pipette tip and transfer the organoids into a new 15 mL falcon tube.
Fill the tube up to 12 mL with ice-cold mouse organoid basic medium.
Centrifuge at 200 g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove approximately 10 mL of supernatant and leave approximately 1.5–2 mL with the pellet.
Pipette up and down 7 times with P-1000 pipette with a 10 μL unfiltered tip attached to a 1000 μL filtered tip.
Remove the old medium.
Slowly add 2 mL pre-warmed PBS on the side of the wells.
Aspirate the PBS and add 1 mL GCDR per well.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 10 min.
Transfer the cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Wash the wells with 2 mL mouse organoid basic medium to collect the rest of the cells and transfer into the 15 mL conical tube.
Pipette up and down 5-10 times with a 10 mL serological pipette attached on a pipette boy.
Take 500 μL cell suspension into a 1.5 mL tube to count the cells during the next step.
Centrifuge the 15 mL conical tube filled with cell suspension at 200 g and 4°C for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with mouse organoid basic medium.
Make serial dilution of the cell suspension to a final concentration of 1*10^4 cells/mL according to counting in Step 7/g-i.
Transfer 8 mL of NCCs suspension at 1*10^4 cells/mL (total 8*10^4 cells) into the 15 mL conical tube containing organoid fragments prepared at Step 6/h to get a final volume of 10 mL.
Centrifuge the remaining NCCs.
Resuspend the pellet in RLT buffer containing β-mercaptoethanol for RNase denaturation.
Store the resuspended NCCs at −80°C for gene quantification.
Add 10 μl of β-mercaptoethanol per 1 ml RLT buffer and mix under a fume hood while wearing protective clothing.
Centrifuge the sample at 200 g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove as much supernatant as possible from the centrifuged pellet.
Resuspend the NCC pellet with 400 μl of Matrigel BMM on ice.
Drop 50 μL of the Matrigel BMM-NCC suspension per well in an 8-well pre-warmed 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 10 minutes.
Add 500 μl of pre-warmed co-culture media without Y27632 to each well.
Get approval from national or local ethical committee for animal experiments.
Handle all procedures according to national ethics guidelines.
Work under a sterile dissection hood with a stereo microscope.
Clean the skin of the mouse with 70% ethanol.
Open the abdomen carefully and take out internal organs.
Cut the lateral sides of spinal bone at a 45° angle using micro-scissors.
Perform anterior laminectomy.
Locate DRG in the intervertebral foramina between vertebrae.
Pick up DRG and transfer directly into petri dishes containing DRG collection medium on ice.
Observe collected DRG under a stereomicroscope.
Cut peripheral and central projections from DRG bodies to avoid fibroblast contamination.
Transfer DRG bodies into new petri dishes containing mouse organoid basic medium on ice.
Make one 50 μL drop of Matrigel BMM organoid suspension in the one well of a pre-warmed 24-well plate.
Embed one DRG body in the droplet with sterile forceps.
Repeat steps for other wells as needed.
Keep Matrigel organoid suspension on ice to avoid solidification of Matrigel.
Incubate the plate at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 10 min.
Add 500 μL pre-warmed co-culture media per well.
Change media with 500 μL pre-warmed co-culture media per well after 3 days.
